LanguageData.CC_Settings_MagicGolemRepair: Golems keep their energy (RimWorld of Magic)
LanguageData.CC_Settings_MagicGolemRepair_Tip: With RimWorld of Magic: a golem lives on its energy, a need of its own. If it loses that need (another mod's rules about needs, or a game version change), it stands frozen, only turning to face where it is ordered, and set dormant it fades over and over. With this on, a golem always keeps the needs its golem lists, and one found without its energy gets it back and refills it from its workstation. Needs the deeper game hooks.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_MagicGolemRepair: With RimWorld of Magic, a golem that lost its energy gets it back instead of standing frozen.
LanguageData.CC_MagicGolem_Repaired: {PAWN_labelShort} had lost its energy and stood frozen. It has its energy back and refills from its workstation.
